Data dictionary

Source: R/kb_data_columns.R
kb_data_columns.Rd

The columns of each data frame that kelpbio fits or predicts from, with their types, units, allowed values, and examples.

Usage

kb_data_columns(dataset = NULL)

Arguments

dataset

A string of the dataset to describe, one of kb_data_columns()$dataset, or NULL for every dataset.

Value

A tibble with one row per dataset and column and the character columns dataset, column, type ("numeric", "integer", "character", "logical", or "rvar"), units (NA for none), allowed (the values accepted), description, and example (a typical value), and the logical column required.

Details

Each dataset is the data frame checked by the data check of the same name: "weight_nereo" by kb_check_data_weight_nereo(), "survey_in_situ" by kb_check_data_survey_in_situ(), etc. A required column must be present; a required column must have no missing values unless allowed says otherwise. Grouping columns (site, year, survey_id) may be factors, and a numeric year or survey_id is converted to character. Other columns are ignored.

The survey_in_situ column plants is required when sizes come from a size sample and must be absent when they come from a size census. The survey_in_situ columns plot_area_m2, canopy_area_m2, and canopy_tide_height_m are either all present or all missing on each row.

See also

Other data checks: kb_check_data_carbon_macro(), kb_check_data_carbon_nereo(), kb_check_data_cover_calibration_macro(), kb_check_data_cover_calibration_nereo(), kb_check_data_nitrogen_macro(), kb_check_data_nitrogen_nereo(), kb_check_data_size_census_macro(), kb_check_data_size_census_nereo(), kb_check_data_size_sample_nereo(), kb_check_data_survey_canopy(), kb_check_data_survey_in_situ(), kb_check_data_weight_macro(), kb_check_data_weight_nereo(), kb_check_data_wetdry_macro(), kb_check_data_wetdry_nereo(), kb_datasets()

Examples

kb_data_columns("weight_nereo")
#> # A tibble: 4 × 8
#>   dataset      column      required type      units allowed  description example
#>   <chr>        <chr>       <lgl>    <chr>     <chr> <chr>    <chr>       <chr>  
#> 1 weight_nereo diameter_mm TRUE     numeric   mm    > 0      The plant … 26.8   
#> 2 weight_nereo weight_kg   TRUE     numeric   kg    > 0      The plant'… 0.73   
#> 3 weight_nereo site        TRUE     character NA    any text The site t… otter_…
#> 4 weight_nereo year        TRUE     integer   NA    whole n… The year t… 2024   
unique(kb_data_columns()$dataset)
#>  [1] "weight_nereo"            "weight_macro"           
#>  [3] "size_sample_nereo"       "size_census_nereo"      
#>  [5] "size_census_macro"       "survey_in_situ"         
#>  [7] "survey_canopy"           "wetdry_nereo"           
#>  [9] "wetdry_macro"            "carbon_nereo"           
#> [11] "carbon_macro"            "nitrogen_nereo"         
#> [13] "nitrogen_macro"          "cover_calibration_nereo"
#> [15] "cover_calibration_macro"
